phase19_768.free: Saved/replayed phase19b original-budget parameters, re-rendered float64; historical phase19 scores also retained
phase19_768.thin: New fits on all768 using original9 checkpoint union, identical seeds and original OMP starts; no reuse of11-checkpoint fits

phase19b_192.free_and_thin: Reuse both frozen phase19b arms, re-render float64; no new fitting or best-of replacement

ALS.block_solver: prefix/suffix Gram eigensolve when min/max eigenvalue ratio>1e-9; otherwise direct design-matrix least squares rcond1e-12
ALS.pilot_history: Initial minimum-norm500-sweep and minimum-change500-sweep pilots retained, including failures. Final uses standard minimum norm2000 sweeps globally; no attention outcome used.

negative_controls.uniform: one deterministic matrix per n; no false replication or inferential p-value
negative_controls.random: 16 iid draws per n, Q,K iid standard normal with d_k64, scaled dot product and causal softmax; no planted lines
negative_controls.parametric_checkpoints: original9-checkpoint union, identical raw starts for both caps

planted_controls.angle_decay: joint empirical active(angle,decay) distribution from all192 free fits first3 budgets, frozen pool
planted_controls.recovery: reconstruction error threshold, no parameter-identifiability claim
planted_controls.checkpoints: single planted k, same four starts and frozen optimizer

masked_positive.generator: positive lognormal U,V; A=tril(UV^T), normalized rows

precision.format: IEEE754 binary16 direct round-to-nearest ties-to-even of every physical line parameter or factor
precision.overflow: explicit failure with null error, never clipping or imputation

statistics.primary: median of within-document paired differences,95percent document-block bootstrap CI and paired win/tie fractions
statistics.wilcoxon: two-sided, document median differences, method auto, zero_method wilcox
statistics.undefined_values: Retain null and reason; no conditional primary aggregation

resources.gpu: only c fitting under flock /tmp/radon-gpu.lock; pause verified own CPU slot2 while GPU active
